reviews.text: It's nice to work with your dogs, so they don't get stressed, well-groomed, clean and sterilized, I recommend it.
Thank you so much Tonia💗 …
Excellent experience, really attention to detail, very easy to use, we washed a golden retriever and a Beagle, everything perfect, excellent prices, we will definitely be back as soon as possible
Everything was taken care of down to the smallest detail... we just washed our pitbull and we both had a blast and felt super comfortable!! We will definitely be back every time it's bath time ❤️

The place is clean, tidy, modern, and has everything you need. I have some concerns about the talking washing machine: the volume is very loud and frightens the dog, it's repetitive, and it's cumbersome. You pay based on the size of your dog, which I understand, but for a 25kg dog, I paid €18 (and everything was done fairly quickly). A professional grooming session costs between €20 and €25. The price may not be competitive, but the service is very useful for its convenience and availability, without having to wait weeks for grooming services to become available. I'm giving it 4 stars in the hope they fix the volume of the machine; it was traumatic for both me and my very scared dog.
Rosario thank you so much💗💗💗 …
Thank you so much Nunzia💚💚💚 …
Thank you so much Martina💚💚💚 …
Excellent service and excellent remote collaboration, I highly recommend

I visited this place with my Husky, Zeus, and I have to say I had a great time!
The place is super clean and well-organized, and the touch controls are incredibly easy to use and make everything very convenient.
One of the things I appreciated most was the ability to pause the time: really convenient for managing everything calmly without wasting time. Furthermore, disinfection is free both before and after washing, a detail that really makes a difference and demonstrates great attention to hygiene.
Highly recommended!

I went to Zampe Zozzose with my dog ​​Birba and I loved it!
I went at night, there were no lines, and everything was super quiet. Birba doesn't get washed by anyone else, just me, so this service was truly indispensable. You don't have to bring anything because everything is already there, and everything is quick and stress-free.
Truly top-notch, I'll definitely be back!

I found this dog wash almost by accident, and I must admit I was a little skeptical about washing my dog ​​there. I went there last week with a friend, and I can only give it a 5-star review. The place is small but comfortable, very clean, and has everything you could possibly need to clean your four-legged friends. Shampoo, conditioner, flea and tick treatment, aprons to wear to keep them from getting wet, cotton pads to clean eyes, cotton swabs for ears, creams for noses and paw pads, clean towels, and combs and brushes of all sizes. There are even toys and balls for a little entertainment! It was a pleasant discovery, and we'll definitely be back!
Thank you so much😘😘 …

Even though it's self-service, the staff are extremely helpful and friendly, and the environment is clean and equipped with every comfort for cleaning and caring for your pet. It was my first time, but I'll definitely be ditching the shower at home and coming here for every future wash.

I have a Spinone named Stellina, and as you can imagine, she gets dirty just looking at her 😅
This place struck me above all for its convenience: you arrive, do everything yourself and without wasting time. It's really convenient.
The cleanliness is immediately noticeable, the environment is well-kept, and this makes you feel at ease, like at home. Plus, it's also a well-kept and pleasant place, modern, not the usual cold and neglected wash.
I washed Stellina without any stress; everything is simple and works as it should. She came out clean and really soft. When you find a service like this, you never leave.

The place is truly beautiful and well-made, but my review is for the owners, who were truly understanding and kind to us. We were inexperienced and unfamiliar, but they immediately made themselves available and helped us step by step with such kindness and expertise. Thank you and congratulations for the idea and for the time you put into it.

I'm Nick's mom, a 90-pound, slightly lively Labrador 😄
I have to say this experience has really won me over.
The location is super convenient, easy to get to, and perfect even when you come back from a walk and realize a bathroom break is inevitable. As soon as you walk in, you immediately feel at ease: the environment is clean, tidy, and well-kept, which really makes a difference for me.
The tubs are modern, spacious, and incredibly easy to use. Even the first time, everything was intuitive and stress-free. Nick was calm the entire time, and I was able to bathe him calmly, using all the amenities available, truly designed by those who love their furry friend.
It's incredibly helpful to be able to do everything independently, at my own pace, and knowing that my Nick is in a safe and well-cared for place. We both left satisfied: Nick clean and relaxed, and I satisfied. An experience we'll definitely repeat.

We used to go to the one in Villaricca, which was great, but this one is closer to the Capodimonte forest, where I always take Nala. It's super convenient, and I always stop by after my Sunday morning walk. The place is always impeccable, easy, and affordable, and you'll find everything you need!
Beautiful place! My little rascal loves it. Very comfortable, clean, and the remote support was incredibly helpful.
I feel like giving it 5 stars because it's an excellent service. The staff is competent and attentive, and the place is very beautiful. 👍🏻 …

Beautiful place, meticulously maintained. Very convenient, because you can freeze time at any moment! I was drawn to the online videos, and I have to say they deserve all the compliments. You have a new customer.

It was a fantastic discovery for us! My Kobei and I have been to other self-service spas because he doesn't want anyone else to wash him, but this one is truly the best. The location is very convenient, the tub is automatic, the products are excellent, and it's incredibly clean. They helped me with the cameras and were very kind. I highly recommend it.

I stayed at this place and had a really great time. The tubs are modern, comfortable, and very easy to use, even for those who aren't used to this type of service.
One thing I really appreciated was the ability to stop the time: this way, the actual time spent is much longer than the amount you pay for, unlike other washes where the time counts even when you're not using the water or the hair dryer. This allows you to wash your dog calmly without feeling like you're "racing against the timer."
The place was spotless and well-kept; you can see the care and attention paid to it. Furthermore, the owners are really kind and helpful: even in the evening, when I went, they answered the phone right away and helped me with any questions. Highly recommended for anyone looking for something truly convenient.
I'm waiting to take a bath

Fantastic! I washed my two dogs without making a mess in my bathroom, spending little and super quickly because they really do everything for you: from washing to drying. When things are done well, the difference is noticeable. I'll be back!

Excellent experience, everything clean, fragrant and sanitized, if they really want to be the best I would add a vending machine with bottles of water and snacks but really a great idea and convenient
Nice self-service dog wash, a little expensive (I paid 18 euros to wash my Pomeranian when the groomer asked me 15 euros) and with some things to improve but for once it can be done
